concept: A knowledge signal travels through a luminous editorial machine and emerges as a clear lesson.
material: dark technical paper with crisp vector ink, thin light paths, and restrained luminous color
motionSignature: Signal-trace: lines draw first, objects follow the line, and the visual settles only after the idea arrives. One motivated transformation per scene.
composition: Large graphic subjects fill the frame. Type is sparse, anchored to an edge, and never competes with the diagram. Each scene uses a distinct silhouette.
signatureMotif: A cyan signal line that changes form from scene to scene: waveform, path, orbit, timeline, and arc.
